verdicts.reason: A: the headline runs almost to the right edge. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow column right next to the CTA. The flavour chips are scattered in the wrong order (Honey Rosemary left, Cucumber Mint off to the right, Blood Orange below), so they no longer read as one group and the layout looks arbitrary. B: the headline, one-line body copy and chips keep the original order on a cleaner left-aligned flow. But the oversized chips nearly match the CTA in weight, the right-aligned CTA floats away from the copy, the Honey Rosemary chip sits jammed near the bottom edge, and the peach circle is awkwardly cropped in the corner.
